text:
maria_marketing: Quick sync — launching the Search + Retarget test today. Plan = staircase budget pacing, creative rotation A/B, 7d high-intent retarget list. Need final UTM + landing ready. @aditya_paid you good on bid schedule?

aditya_paid: Yep. Setting staircase ramp: 25% / 50% / 75% / 100% across first 4 days. Daily caps enabled. Do we want hour-of-day throttling for US peak? Also need final tracking macro.

olivia_design: Final creatives uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1exampleLink — Creative_A (headline-focused) and Creative_B (value props). Small CTA test: 'Try Redwood for free' vs 'Start free trial' — leaning B for capture.

jason_growth: Leaning 'Start free trial' for search intents. Also add webinar promo token for registrants. UTM plan: utm_campaign=launch_may, utm_source=google, utm_medium=cpc, utm_content=creativeA|creativeB. We'll append ?promo=webinar when sending webinar-specific ads.

maria_marketing: UTM snippet for ad team (copy/paste):
```
https://redwood.ai/try?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=launch_may&utm_content=creativeA&utm_term={keyword}
```
Landing is /try — QA to ensure server-side capture of utm params.

aditya_paid: Uploading ad group config now. Sample settings I'm pushing: 
```
ad_group: "Launch-Top-Keywords"
bid_strategy: max_clicks
daily_cap: 2000
staircase_ramp: [25,50,75,100]
creative_rotation: rotate_evenly
retarget_list: 7d_high_intent
```
I'll map goal to 'lead' conversion.

campaign-bot: [scheduled task] adops-checklist created by @aditya_paid — tracking ping in 10m, spend alarm thresholds at $1k, $5k.

sam_ops: Quick numbers — 30d site visitors = 120k, 7d = 18k. Recommend using 7d list for the initial retargeting window and exclude 0-3d to avoid overexposure.

jason_growth: Also: creative rotation cadence — swap winners every 48h, pause losers if CTR < 0.6% and CPA > target. Add a control creative for benchmark.

maria_marketing: Webinar note: schedule for May 12, 10am PT. We'll include a CTA in remarketing sequence 3 days prior. Exclude registrants from paid retarget ads the week after registration.

aditya_paid: Pushing campaigns at 11:00 PT to avoid morning volume. I'll start at 75% pacing until we validate conversion funnels, then open to 100% if stable. Posting final ad IDs in 5.

olivia_design: Small tweak: swapped headline on Creative_B to emphasize latency/cost. Uploaded final PNGs and mobile crops.

maria_marketing: QA checklist before push: 1) UTM capture working, 2) Pixel firing (GA4 + Ads), 3) Landing copy matches creative, 4) Promo token appends. React :rocket: when done.

aditya_paid: All done — scripts uploaded, pixels passed, campaign scheduled at 11:00. I'll monitor first hour and hold pacing if CPA spikes. :thumbsup:

campaign-bot: Launch scheduled by @aditya_paid for 1876543210 at 11:00 PT. Task id=78901. First automated spend update in 60m.

maria_marketing: Perfect — thanks everyone. Post any early anomalies here and we'll decide on ramp changes. Good luck :sparkles:
